description: This Java interface defines a 'Subject' model used within a policy system, including factory methods for creating instances and JSON serialization details.

classes.name: Subject
classes.description: An interface representing a credentialed entity within a policy, with methods for instantiation and JSON serialization. It also provides accessors for the subject's ID and type, and supports JSON schema versioning.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory methods for creating new Subject instances with various combinations of issuer, subject, subject type, and subject ID.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the JSON schema versions supported by Subject, specifically V_2.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the Subject.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Retrieves the type of the Subject.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Subject to a JSON object, including only non-hidden fields.
